slides.title: 5 Claude Code habits that save me hours
Start in plan mode
slides.body: Let it read the code and propose a plan before touching a file. You review the plan, not 300 lines of diff.

slides.title: Turn repeated prompts into skills
slides.body: If you explain the same thing twice, write it once as a skill. Then it's one command.

slides.title: Give it a way to check itself
slides.body: Tests, a linter, or a script it can run.
slides.code:
"Run pytest after every change
and fix what breaks."
